The retry helper waits longer after each failure and gives up after three attempts:

```python
def fetch_with_retry(url, attempts=3):
    for n in range(attempts):
        try:
            return fetch(url)
        except TimeoutError:
            sleep(2 ** n)
    raise GiveUp(url)
```

The same logic as a picture:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  start(["Request"]) --> try["Fetch the URL"]
  try --> ok{"Answer in time?"}
  ok -->|yes| done(["Return the page"])
  ok -->|no| more{"Attempts left?"}:::focus
  more -->|yes| wait["Wait 2^n seconds"]
  wait --> try
  more -->|no| fail(["Raise GiveUp"])
```

A timeout is the only error that is retried; any other exception reaches the caller at once.
